findings.claim: The company panel does not render the admin_otp_login_enabled switch, so the only kill-switch for the TOTP-bypassing OTP login path can be neither seen nor toggled from the UI. The panel iterates a hard-coded client label map (6 keys) instead of the server's FEATURE_FLAG_KEYS (7 keys); the API does return the flag.

findings.claim: On an http(s) deployment, a network failure/timeout during login drops the operator into the DEMO dashboard (labelled banner + [DEMO] names + toast) instead of showing an error with retry. This contradicts the shared transport rule that http(s) failures must be errors, not sample data, and masks a production outage at the most important entry point. Applies to the password path and both OTP steps.

findings.claim: Five views derived from the RESTAURANTS array (overview, restaurants, analytics, billing, support) have no loading state and no error+retry state: ANY failure of GET /admin/restaurants (including 500 or 401 after a failed refresh) substitutes the [DEMO] dataset with the offline banner. findings.area: views > error state without in-place retry
findings.claim: Eight fetch-driven views/panels render an honest error message but offer no retry control; recovery only by re-navigating in the sidebar (which does re-fetch). Sales, photos, hours and the security sub-panels do have retry.

The provisioning Idempotency-Key is built ad hoc from Date.now()+Math.random() instead of the shared genIdempotencyKey() (crypto.randomUUID) exported by api-core.js: duplicate logic and weaker entropy. Collision risk is negligible because the server scopes the key per admin.

Platform-admin access and refresh tokens are persisted in localStorage (rz_co_access / rz_co_refresh), i.e. exfiltrable by any XSS in the panel. Mitigated by the esc/jsq discipline and the XSS-sink gate, and by refresh re-checking staff.isActive server-side. Informational.

GET /api/v1/auth/admin/login is unauthenticated and has no rate limit; it discloses only two booleans (totp_required, otp_login_enabled) which the code documents as non-secret. Informational; the POST is rate-limited on two dimensions.
